_what: DEFECT — a COMPOSITE inherits its registration REFERENCE MEMBER's header for every key the stamps do not replace. PIPEREV was the found instance; the census below measures the full leak surface. General form: leak surface of a route = (reference header) − (keys siril recomputes) − (the stamp allow-lists that route applies).

measured.reading: both composites carry their reference member's stamp exactly; neither carries the building code's

leak_census.method: every header key of stack_july31+aug06+aug09+aug14_full.fit classified against its reference member (aug09/groups_set-02/sub_02) and all 77 members' headers (sessions/*/work/groups_set-0[1-9]/sub_*.fit; count = NMEMBER = 77, member PIPEREV census matches rebuild_scope.json's era census exactly)

CALSET.note: the SINGULAR key. ebbce14's GAP 2 names CALSET inheritance as the defect it fixes, added the plural CALSETS, and never replaced the singular — its own worked example still ships on the product. CALSET is not in the KEYS tuple.

DATE-OBS.note: the reference SET's start on an aug01-aug15 product. siril's own EXPSTART/EXPEND on the composite carry the true span (JD 2461253.619 -> 2461267.709).

GRPSIZE.note: the reference sub-stack's group size. No active consumer reads a composite's GRPSIZE (the resume guard reads sub_NN.fit only); latent for readers.

leak_census.reference_keyed_not_first_member: the old/new corpus pair discriminates: old (ref = member 1) leaks july31/set-01 / 2026-08-01 / 100 / 5b48421; new (ref = 36, first member still 1) leaks aug09/set-02 / 2026-08-10 / 114 / 1791bb4 — each matches its own reference
leak_census.inherited_uniform_today: the acquisition block — EXPTIME APERTURE ISOSPEED FOCALLEN XPIXSZ YPIXSZ XBINNING YBINNING INSTRUME (+ CUNIT1/2 EQUINOX LONPOLE MIPS-FLO) — reads 1 distinct value across all 77, so it mis-asserts nothing until a corpus mixes values. Standing trigger: july27 is 3.0 s against this corpus's uniform 2.5 s, so EXPTIME fires on any future mixed corpus (BACKLOG:final-best-percent-pass class).
leak_census.recomputed_by_siril_verified: STACKCNT 8349 = sum(member STACKCNT) exactly; LIVETIME 20872.5 = sum exactly (the stamp docstring's 'summed correctly' is MEASURED, not assumed); EXPSTART/EXPEND; OBJCTRA/OBJCTDEC/RA/DEC; the composite WCS (new CRPIX/CRVAL/PC/CDELT; CTYPE RA---TAN against members' RA---TAN-SIP — the registry's WCS-trap family)
leak_census.replaced_correctly: the 15-key composite tuple behaves as designed: CALFLAT MIXED(13), CALFSUM MIXED(5), DISTA/B/C common, NMEMBER 77, CALSETS, PROVMIX T

route_classes.run_undistort_groups_finals: BOTH allow-lists applied post-stack (header_stamp_lines + header_provenance_lines, run_undistort_groups.sh). MEASURED: aug06 stack_set-01_full.fit reads PIPEREV 1791bb4 while its own reference sub_01 carries a1dc91b — the re-stamp is live. Residual leak: GRPSIZE (reads sub_01's 100) and FILENAME. DATE-OBS is STAMPED there (_STAMP_KEYS ends with it), not inherited — and every sub of a set carries the SAME DATE-OBS anyway (measured 4/4 aug09/set-02, 5/5 july31/set-01; all stamped from one set-level acq_header capture), so reference choice cannot move it today. That hazard activates only if per-group epochs ever land — observer_frame_diversity.py's registered removal condition.
route_classes.run_undistort_compose_products: the composite KEYS tuple + registration lines ONLY — the leak class above: PIPEREV, singular CALSET, DATE-OBS, GRPSIZE, FILENAME, and the uniform-today acquisition block
route_classes.run_pipeline_and_compose_py: NO stamps at all (grep: zero hits in run_pipeline.sh, compose.py, finish_render.sh, render_tier.sh, build_sky_flat.sh) — PIPEREV absent rather than false, and rgbcomp composites never received the ebbce14 composite-identity fix. CLAUDE.md's PIPEREV sentence is in practice scoped to the undistort chain.

intent: oversight with a traceable moment, not a weighed exclusion: PIPEREV stamping entered a307999 (2026-08-09); the composite tuple entered ebbce14 (2026-08-10) with a message that enumerates GAP 2 entirely in calibration/optics terms and never mentions PIPEREV; git log -S PIPEREV on stamp_headers.sh returns only a307999

list: datasets/aug06/experiments.jsonl l1_background_level_perframe_vs_onstack control fingerprint (3-set union, PIPEREV a1dc91b)
carriers_in_tracked_records.use_class: identity fingerprint (verifying the artifact unchanged) — valid as a fingerprint, wrong if ever read as build-code. A reader dating a union from any of these is reading the reference member.
carriers_in_tracked_records.conclusions_resting_on_one: ZERO found. Sweep = git grep piperev over tracked files + all commit messages matching piperev; the one claim resting on composite-PIPEREV semantics was this record's own withdrawn 'uniform stamp' clause in rebuild_scope.json. Escape class: reasoning that used a composite's PIPEREV without writing the word nearby.

mechanism: siril `stack` propagates the reference image's header into the output. stamp_headers.sh's header_composite_provenance_lines exists precisely to REPLACE inherited keys, and its KEYS tuple (DISTMODL DISTA DISTB DISTC DISTNORM DISTRHO ...) does NOT include PIPEREV — nor CALSET, DATE-OBS, GRPSIZE, FILENAME, nor the acquisition block. An allow-list of keys to fix is a deny-list-by-omission of keys to leak.
why_it_matters: CLAUDE.md states 'PIPEREV is git rev-parse --short HEAD (stamp_headers.sh), so a commit stamps every artifact built after it'. That is TRUE for members and per-set groups finals and FALSE for run_undistort_compose products. Any reasoning that dates or attributes a composite from PIPEREV, CALSET or DATE-OBS — including a scope decision about whether a rebuild is needed — is reading the reference member. This is the same failure class the stamper's own docstring describes for CALSET: 'worse than an absent stamp: a gate reading it is told a confident falsehood.'
how_it_was_found: the REGREF stamp added in this unit names the member whose header leaked, which is what made the inheritance diagnosable rather than merely puzzling
FIXED: owner-directed. The stamp now emits the composite's own identity (stamp_headers.sh: CALSET joins the KEYS tuple, PIPEREV = HEAD at compose, DATE-OBS = earliest member start = the ISO of EXPSTART, GRPSIZE/FILENAME deleted via a new delete_key applier verb). A/B at the emitter: old vs new on the same 77 members differs by exactly the intended five lines, 18 pre-existing lines byte-identical.
BACKFILLED: 15 files, every DATA BLOCK verified bit-identical by sha256 before/after (scripts/stack/backfill_composite_identity.sh): the corpus trio (PIPEREV = 9106bc4, the RECORDED build commit; CALSET MIXED(17); DATE-OBS 2026-08-01T02:51:17), the july31/aug09/aug14 night trios and the superseded 3-night trio (CALSET MIXED(4)/MIXED(5)/MIXED(5)/MIXED(12); PIPEREV DELETED — their build commits are unrecorded, and an absent stamp beats a confidently false one). EXCLUDED deliberately: the aug06 union trio (the pre-registered l1 experiment in datasets/aug06/experiments.jsonl pins its header values as the control fingerprint — a backfill would break a live control) and the wnbstack/wnoise experiment-arm trios (wnbstack is md5-pinned in corpus4_build_record.json). The leak_census fields above describe the PRE-backfill state and stay as the defect's measurement.
